text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, during training, I sense
someone staring
at me. I turn to check,
only to find...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
An unfamiliar woman is watching our
session
intently. I figure that she's just a
fan or spectator
and try to shrug it off.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But... she stays there standing around,
even after
the training's over. Was she
waiting for me?

Oh, apologies. Did I disturb your
training session?

That's a relief! I was actually hoping to
borrow
you for a couple questions, if
you have a minute.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: My name is Etsuko Otonashi. I'm a reporter from Twinkle Monthly.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
I was in awe watching you and your
trainee
practice. I'd love to write a story
about you two
and your activities to
show my support. If that's
okay with you,
of course.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She seems like a polite person, and she
sounds
sincere. Not to mention, a
well-written article
would bring
<chrname> more fans.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much. Then, let's get right
to it...
What criteria do you consider
when developing
your training regimen?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
I see. So in short, your role as a trainer
is...
choice_data_list: I'm thinking carefully about how to help her seize her dream.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
choice_data_list: To help an Umamusume achieve her dreams!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
It appears that you're ready to do
anything to
help your trainee attain her
dreams!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Training wherever and whenever she
asks! Taking
her on hot spring tours to
recover from races!
Venturing to remote
mountain streams just to
fetch her a cup
of water!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Ah... What devotion... I'm so moved! I
promise my
article will instill a fiery
passion in all who read it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And just like that, I think I got in the good books of a very inspired ally.
